description.zh: 请求来源标识，固定取值为**sas**。
description.en: The request source identifier. Set this parameter to **sas**.

description.zh:
日志存放的专属Logstore名称。
>您可以调用[DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The name of the dedicated Logstore where logs are stored.
>You can call the [DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
Project名称。
> 您可以调用[DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The project name.
> You can call the [DescribeLogMeta](~~DescribeLogMeta~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
资源目录成员账号ID（阿里云账号）。
>调用[DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~)接口可以获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the member account in the resource directory (Alibaba Cloud account).
>Call the [DescribeMonitorAccounts](~~DescribeMonitorAccounts~~) operation to obtain this parameter.

description.zh:
指定需要修改的日志的状态。取值：
- **enabled**：启用
- **disabled**：禁用
description.en:
The status to which you want to change the log. Valid values:
- **enabled**: enabled
- **disabled**: disabled.

title.zh: 修改日志分析启用状态

example.unifiedCli: aliyun sas modify-log-meta-status --from sas --project aegis-log --log-store aegis-log-login --status disabled --resource-directory-account-id 12324284232340000 --api-version 2018-12-03 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun sas ModifyLogMetaStatus --region cn-hangzhou --Status disabled --Project 'aegis-log' --LogStore 'aegis-log-login' --ResourceDirectoryAccountId 12324284232340000 --From sas
